plugins.name: ui-polish
plugins.description: Design-mirror pass that fixes bad AI frontend output. Captures the current UI state, extracts a reference design system (colors, spacing, type scale, radii, shadows) from a real site's CSS or the user's design tokens file, diffs the two, and applies presentation-only fixes in small batches until visual parity. Never touches functionality. Note: pixel-level visual parity cannot be guaranteed; the loop stops when the user says it looks right or the diff stops shrinking.
